news.title: U.S. SEC to again delay 'innovation exemption' for tokenization amid Wall Street, White House concerns
news.summary: The SEC was ready to release at least some part of the innovation exemption alongside its now-canceled open meeting for "Reg Crypto" on Friday.

news.title: SEC cancels long-awaited proposal of Reg Crypto, postponing meeting without new date
news.summary: The first major crypto rule to be proposed by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission will have to wait a bit longer after a sudden postponement.

news.title: Tether says it completed long-promised 'Big Four' audit of finances behind $180 billion USDT stablecoin
news.summary: KPMG U.S. examined Tether's books and even counted its gold bars as the $180 billion USDT issuer said it completed its long-promised financial audit.
